description: This Java source file defines a final class DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, which provides a builder pattern implementation for creating responses and events related to deleting a feature definition in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing different response types (successful deletion, error responses) and corresponding event objects.
